messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging alert: elevated decode tail latency in us-west-2 (service=inference-prod). p95 jumped to ~420ms (baseline ~85ms), p99 at ~1.82s (baseline ~120ms). Multiple streaming stalls and client reconnects observed. Alert triggered 2026-02-14T02:14Z. https://dash.redwood/internal/alerts/6574839201

Ashwin (oncall): I'm on it. Saw an inflection at ~02:12Z that lines up with yesterday's kernel rollout. Can someone confirm what went out? @Ben?

Ben (runtime): Confirmed we rolled kernel build trt8-2026-02 (includes TRT8 runtime + FlashAttention enabled) at 02:10Z to canary and promoted to 100% at 02:11Z. Also enabled new compiler flags: `-O3 -funroll-loops -funsafe-math-optimizations`. Perf lab looked fine on p50/p90 but I didn't see long streaming tails in short runs.

Clara (sre): On hosts gpunode-41..48 I'm seeing repeated VM faults and elevated page faults around the same time: `nvmm: excessive TLB miss` and `cuda: context sync timeout`. Sample logs: 
```
[02:12:07] gpunode-45 kernel: nv_page_fault: mmu 0x1f - excessive TLB misses, eviction triggered
[02:12:11] gpu-runtime: cudaMemcpy timeout after 3000ms, stream stalled, client reconnect
[02:12:15] inference: decode loop stalled waiting on kv cache warm
```

Ashwin (oncall): That matches the customer reports of streaming disconnects. Hypothesis: new kernel / compile flags + FlashAttention change memory usage patterns causing more KV eviction / TLB pressure -> tail latencies.

Ben (runtime): Agreed. Quick repro for the team to run on a perf node: 
```
python perf/repro_decode.py --model gpt-j-6b --seq 2048 --backend trt8 --kernel trt8-2026-02 --batch 8 --streaming
```
This reproduces p99 > 1s in our lab within a few minutes.

Clara (sre): I see the same on a perf node. Also confirmed kernel symbols show bigger shared memory footprint for FlashAttention kernels. Likely eviction/backpressure when sequence lengths spike.

Ashwin (oncall): Mitigation plan (short):
1) Start partial rollback to trt7-stable for 20% of serving fleet (route warm sessions there).
2) Enable streaming fallback (route long-running streaming sessions -> compact model variant) at 30% for safety.
3) Reduce `max_batch` on streaming lanes from 8 -> 4 to reduce transient memory pressure.
4) Temporary enable `eviction_backoff=true` in runtime to avoid immediate re-eviction.

deploy-bot: Rolling update triggered: job=rollback-kernel-6574839201, target=20% of us-west-2 serving nodes, from trt8-2026-02 -> trt7-stable. ETA ~6m.

Ashwin (oncall): Pushing runtime config change now:
```
curl -XPOST https://internal-api.redwood/config \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"selector":"us-west-2","eviction_backoff":true,"max_batch":4,"streaming_fallback":{"percent":30}}'
```

Clara (sre): After rollback started I'm seeing p99 drop on rolled hosts: rolled-hosts p99 ~700ms, global p99 down to ~1.1s (from 1.82s). Streaming stall count decreased by ~45% on rolled nodes.

Ben (runtime): I'm building a triage kernel: disable `-funsafe-math-optimizations` and remove loop unrolling for the problematic FlashAttention kernels. Will run long-run streaming repros in staging and share perf artifacts. If that looks good we'll cut trt8-patch-01 and canary at 5% first.

Dave (support): Customer impact: two Tier-1 customers reported streaming disconnects and intermittent 504s between 02:12-02:30Z. We opened support tickets and added them to the incident list. No data corruption reported; sessions resumed for most after reconnect. PR sent to status page for incident notification.

Ashwin (oncall): Status post drafted and will publish once rollback completes and p99 stabilizes under 300ms on canaries. Also emailing AMs.

Ben (runtime): Quick note on root cause theory: FlashAttention kernel version in trt8-2026-02 increased shared-memory and register pressure for large sequences. Combined with aggressive compiler optimizations we probably changed memory access patterns -> more TLB churn and eviction of KV pages during decode. The symptom looks like paging causing context sync timeouts.

Clara (sre): We'll keep memory pressure metrics (SM usage, TLB misses, pagefaults) on the incident dashboard. Link: https://dash.redwood/internal/graphs/kernel-memory?from=6574839000&to=6574840200

deploy-bot: Rollback job=rollback-kernel-6574839201 completed on 20% targets in 5m20s. No failures.

Ashwin (oncall): Good. Global p95 down to ~120ms, p99 ~420ms and trending down. Still higher than baseline — keep the rollout paused until Ben's patch is validated.

Ben (runtime): Patch build queued: trt8-patch-01 (disables `-funsafe-math-optimizations`, reduces unrolling for FA kernel). Running 30m streaming soak in staging. Will post perf logs once finished.

Dave (support): Posted incident update to status.redwood.com and emailed affected customers. Updated tickets with ETA for full mitigation ~+3h.

Ashwin (oncall): Handoff to @Maya (next-oncall): actions for next shift:
- Monitor p95/p99 for us-west-2 and global streaming stalls dashboard.
- Ensure trt8-patch-01 soak completes and validate p99 in staging before any re-promote.
- Coordinate with Ben to canary trt8-patch-01 at 5% and monitor memory/TLB metrics.
- Keep support loop with Dave for customer comms.

Maya (next-oncall): Ack, will pick up the list. Please add any additional artifacts to the incident thread. :thumbsup:

Ashwin (oncall): Final note: root cause still under investigation (kernel+compiler flags+FlashAttention interaction). Creating follow-up postmortem ticket and assigning to Ben/Clara for deeper kernel forensic + to runtime tests for longer streaming e2e runs. :white_check_mark:
